Boundary points are peeled so the interior loop is branch-free\n// and vectorizable.\ntemplate <typename F>\ninline void laplacianRow(const double* __restrict c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                         const size_t y, const size_t z, const double dx2, const double dy2,\n                         const double dz2, F&& f) noexcept {\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n\n    const double* __restrict row   = c + z * plane + y * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowYn = c + z * plane + yn * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowYp = c + z * plane + yp * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowZn = c + zn * plane + y * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowZp = c + zp * plane + y * nx;\n\n    if (nx == 1) {\n        f(0, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, 0, 0, 0, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // x = 0 (clamped left neighbour)\n    f(0, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, 0, 0, 1, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n\n    // interior\n#pragma omp simd\n    for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {\n        f(x, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, x, x - 1, x + 1, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n    }\n\n    // x = nx-1 (clamped right neighbour)\n    f(nx - 1, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, nx - 1, nx - 2, nx - 1, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential. Must be called from inside an OpenMP parallel\n// region; work is distributed with an orphaned worksharing loop.\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const double* __restrict c, double* __restrict mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    const double dx2 = dx * dx;\n    const double dy2 = dy * dy;\n    const double dz2 = dz * dz;\n#pragma omp for collapse(2) schedule(static) nowait\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            const size_t base = idx3(0, y, z, nx, ny);\n            const double* __restrict crow = c + base;\n            double* __restrict murow = mu + base;\n            laplacianRow(c, nx, ny, nz, y, z, dx2, dy2, dz2, [=](const size_t x, const double lap) {\n                const double cv = crow[x];\n                murow[x] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB)\n                           + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                           - gamma * lap;\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step. barrier\n            // Update concentration\n            cahnHilliardUpdate(pnew, pold, pmu, nx, ny, nz, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n#pragma omp barrier\n            // Swap buffers\n            std::swap(pold, pnew);\n        }\n    }\n    // Mirror the per-step buffer swaps on the owning vectors.\n    if (iterations % 2 != 0) {\n        std::swap(cold, cnew);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgaF6rz4gWYgMxBpzf2yz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AcRPawMb7AXFyytrR4fnD3","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd cahn-hilliard && python3 - <<'EOF'\np='cahn_hilliard.cpp'; s=open(p).read()\nstart=s.index('// Pin each OpenMP thread'); end=s.index('// 3D index calculation')\nnew='''// Read a small integer from a sysfs topology file; returns -1 on failure.\nstatic int readSysfsInt(const char* path) {\n    FILE* f = fopen(path, \"r\");\n    if (!f) return -1;\n    int v = -1;\n    if (fscanf(f, \"%d\", &v) != 1) v = -1;\n    fclose(f);\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to one CPU from the process's allowed CPU set.\n// Without binding, libgomp's thread pool migrates between cores and sockets\n// and this barrier-heavy stencil loses most of its scalability. The mapping is\n// NUMA-aware: thread ids are split into contiguous blocks per package (so the\n// contiguous z-slabs handed out by schedule(static) stay socket-local, with a\n// single cross-socket halo), and within a package physical cores are filled\n// before SMT siblings. User-provided OMP_PROC_BIND / OMP_PLACES settings take\n// precedence and disable this.\nstatic void pinOpenMPThreads() {\n    if (getenv(\"OMP_PROC_BIND\") != nullptr || getenv(\"OMP_PLACES\") != nullptr) return;\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) return;\n\n    struct CpuInfo { int cpu; int pkg; int core; };\n    std::vector<CpuInfo> cpus;\n    for (int i = 0; i < CPU_SETSIZE; ++i) {\n        if (!CPU_ISSET(i, &allowed)) continue;\n        char path[128];\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/physical_package_id\", i);\n        const int pkg = readSysfsInt(path);\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/core_id\", i);\n        const int core = readSysfsInt(path);\n        cpus.push_back({i, pkg < 0 ? 0 : pkg, core < 0 ? i : core});\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) return;\n\n    // Group by package (sorted by package id, then core id, then cpu id).\n    std::sort(cpus.begin(), cpus.end(), [](const CpuInfo& a, const CpuInfo& b) {\n        if (a.pkg != b.pkg) return a.pkg < b.pkg;\n        if (a.core != b.core) return a.core < b.core;\n        return a.cpu < b.cpu;\n    });\n    // Within each package, order as: all first SMT threads of every core, then\n    // all second SMT threads, ... so low thread counts use distinct cores.\n    std::vector<int> order;\n    order.reserve(cpus.size());\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < cpus.size();) {\n        size_t e = b;\n        while (e < cpus.size() && cpus[e].pkg == cpus[b].pkg) ++e;\n        // assign smt index within core\n        std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> keyed;  // (smt index, position)\n        for (size_t i = b; i < e; ++i) {\n            int smt = 0;\n            for (size_t j = i; j > b && cpus[j - 1].core == cpus[i].core; --j) ++smt;\n            keyed.push_back({smt, static_cast<int>(i)});\n        }\n        std::stable_sort(keyed.begin(), keyed.end(),\n                         [](const std::pair<int, int>& a, const std::pair<int, int>& b2) { return a.first < b2.first; });\n        for (const auto& k : keyed) order.push_back(cpus[k.second].cpu);\n        b = e;\n    }\n    const size_t ncpu = order.size();\n\n    // Count packages and their sizes so each gets a contiguous block of threads.\n    std::vector<size_t> pkgSize;\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < cpus.size();) {\n        size_t e = b;\n        while (e < cpus.size() && cpus[e].pkg == cpus[b].pkg) ++e;\n        pkgSize.push_back(e - b);\n        b = e;\n    }\n\n    const size_t nthreads = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads());\n    std::vector<int> map(nthreads);\n    if (nthreads >= ncpu || pkgSize.size() <= 1) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < nthreads; ++t) map[t] = order[t % ncpu];\n    } else {\n        // Distribute threads over packages proportionally to package size.\n        size_t t = 0, off = 0;\n        for (size_t p = 0; p < pkgSize.size(); ++p) {\n            const size_t want = (p + 1 == pkgSize.size()) ? (nthreads - t)\n                                                          : (nthreads * pkgSize[p] + ncpu / 2) / ncpu;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < want && t < nthreads; ++k, ++t) map[t] = order[off + (k % pkgSize[p])];\n            off += pkgSize[p];\n        }\n    }\n\n#pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const size_t tid = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num());\n        if (tid < map.size()) {\n            cpu_set_t mine;\n            CPU_ZERO(&mine);\n            CPU_SET(map[tid], &mine);\n            sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(mine), &mine);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:start]+new+s[end:]\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build /tmp/chbuild 2>&1 | grep -E \"warning|error\"; B=/tmp/chbuild/cahn_hilliard\nrun(){ for r in 1 2 3; do $B -x 256 -i 20 | grep Perf | awk '{printf \"%s \", $2}'; done; echo; }\nfor T in 256 128 64 32; do echo -n \"T=$T: \"; OMP_NUM_THREADS=$T run; done\necho -n \"T=256 i=100: \"; $B -x 256 -i 100 | grep -E \"time|Perf\" | tr '\\n' ' '; echo\necho -n \"T=128 i=100: \"; OMP_NUM_THREADS=128 $B -x 256 -i 100 | grep -E \"time|Perf\" | tr '\\n' ' '; echo","description":"Implement topology-aware pinning and measure across thread counts","timeout":600000},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5377,"cache_read_input_tokens":35200,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":5377},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3f2f82c0-8753-4645-91c3-7ec5487704b7","uuid":"91c89fc7-c96f-4feb-845f-d34aabfce7f4","timestamp":"2026-10-31T11:35:20.762Z","request_id":"req_011CgaF6rWHqtiNxqqGLHLG9"}

The mapping is\n// NUMA-aware: thread ids are split into contiguous blocks per package, so the\n// contiguous z-slabs handed out by schedule(static) stay socket-local with a\n// single cross-socket halo. Within a package, if the threads fit on distinct\n// physical cores each gets its own core; otherwise SMT siblings receive\n// adjacent thread ids so they share cache on neighbouring slabs. User-provided\n// OMP_PROC_BIND / OMP_PLACES settings take precedence and disable this.\nstatic void pinOpenMPThreads() {\n    if (getenv(\"OMP_PROC_BIND\") != nullptr || getenv(\"OMP_PLACES\") != nullptr) return;\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) return;\n\n    struct CpuInfo { int cpu; int pkg; int core; };\n    std::vector<CpuInfo> cpus;\n    for (int i = 0; i < CPU_SETSIZE; ++i) {\n        if (!CPU_ISSET(i, &allowed)) continue;\n        char path[128];\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/physical_package_id\", i);\n        const int pkg = readSysfsInt(path);\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/core_id\", i);\n        const int core = readSysfsInt(path);\n        cpus.push_back({i, pkg < 0 ? 0 : pkg, core < 0 ? i : core});\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) return;\n\n    std::sort(cpus.begin(), cpus.end(), [](const CpuInfo& a, const CpuInfo& b) {\n        if (a.pkg != b.pkg) return a.pkg < b.pkg;\n        if (a.core != b.core) return a.core < b.core;\n        return a.cpu < b.cpu;\n    });\n\n    // Split into packages: [begin, end) ranges into 'cpus'.\n    std::vector<std::pair<size_t, size_t>> pkgs;\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < cpus.size();) {\n        size_t e = b;\n        while (e < cpus.size() && cpus[e].pkg == cpus[b].pkg) ++e;\n        pkgs.push_back({b, e});\n        b = e;\n    }\n    const size_t ncpu = cpus.size();\n    const size_t nthreads = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads());\n\n    std::vector<int> map(nthreads);\n    size_t t = 0;\n    for (size_t p = 0; p < pkgs.size(); ++p) {\n        const size_t b = pkgs[p].first, e = pkgs[p].second, size = e - b;\n        // Threads for this package: proportional share, remainder to the last one.\n        const size_t want = (p + 1 == pkgs.size()) ? (nthreads - t)\n                                                   : (nthreads * size + ncpu / 2) / ncpu;\n        if (want == 0) continue;\n\n        // Sibling-adjacent order is the sorted order itself. Core-first order\n        // takes the k-th SMT thread of every core before the (k+1)-th.\n        std::vector<int> siblingAdjacent, coreFirst;\n        siblingAdjacent.reserve(size);\n        coreFirst.reserve(size);\n        size_t ncores = 0;\n        for (size_t i = b; i < e; ++i) {\n            siblingAdjacent.push_back(cpus[i].cpu);\n            if (i == b || cpus[i].core != cpus[i - 1].core) ++ncores;\n        }\n        for (size_t k = 0; coreFirst.size() < size; ++k) {\n            for (size_t i = b; i < e; ++i) {\n                size_t smt = 0;\n                for (size_t j = i; j > b && cpus[j - 1].core == cpus[i].core; --j) ++smt;\n                if (smt == k) coreFirst.push_back(cpus[i].cpu);\n            }\n        }\n        const std::vector<int>& order = (want <= ncores) ? coreFirst : siblingAdjacent;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < want && t < nthreads; ++k, ++t) map[t] = order[k % size];\n    }\n    // Any threads left over (only if the rounding above fell short) wrap around.\n    for (; t < nthreads; ++t) map[t] = cpus[t % ncpu].cpu;\n\n#pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const size_t tid = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num());\n        if (tid < map.size()) {\n            cpu_set_t mine;\n            CPU_ZERO(&mine);\n            CPU_SET(map[tid], &mine);\n            sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(mine), &mine);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:start]+new+s[end:]\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build /tmp/chbuild 2>&1 | grep -E \"warning|error\"; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgaFMwR8HynpWXPEghAVs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01F9UEjxPKwy8aFbpZ9j2j1F","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\np='cahn_hilliard.cpp'; s=open(p).read()\nstart=s.index('// Read a small integer'); end=s.index('// 3D index calculation')\nnew='''// Read a small integer from a sysfs file; returns -1 on failure.\nstatic int readSysfsInt(const char* path) {\n    FILE* f = fopen(path, \"r\");\n    if (!f) return -1;\n    int v = -1;\n    if (fscanf(f, \"%d\", &v) != 1) v = -1;\n    fclose(f);\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to one CPU from the process's allowed CPU set.\n// Without binding, libgomp's thread pool migrates between cores and sockets\n// and this barrier-heavy stencil loses most of its scalability. The mapping is\n// topology-aware:\n//  * thread ids are split into contiguous blocks per package, so the\n//    contiguous z-slabs handed out by schedule(static) stay socket-local with\n//    a single cross-socket halo;\n//  * within a package, consecutive threads are spread round-robin over the L3\n//    domains (core complexes) so that partial thread counts still enjoy the\n//    full aggregate last-level cache;\n//  * if the threads fit on distinct physical cores each gets its own core,\n//    otherwise SMT siblings receive adjacent thread ids so they share cache on\n//    neighbouring slabs.\n// User-provided OMP_PROC_BIND / OMP_PLACES settings take precedence and\n// disable this.\nstatic void pinOpenMPThreads() {\n    if (getenv(\"OMP_PROC_BIND\") != nullptr || getenv(\"OMP_PLACES\") != nullptr) return;\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) return;\n\n    struct CpuInfo { int cpu; int pkg; int l3; int core; int smt; };\n    std::vector<CpuInfo> cpus;\n    for (int i = 0; i < CPU_SETSIZE; ++i) {\n        if (!CPU_ISSET(i, &allowed)) continue;\n        char path[160];\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/physical_package_id\", i);\n        const int pkg = readSysfsInt(path);\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/core_id\", i);\n        const int core = readSysfsInt(path);\n        // L3 domain id: first CPU listed as sharing the L3 cache.\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/cache/index3/shared_cpu_list\", i);\n        const int l3 = readSysfsInt(path);\n        cpus.push_back({i, pkg < 0 ? 0 : pkg, l3 < 0 ? 0 : l3, core < 0 ? i : core, 0});\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) return;\n\n    std::sort(cpus.begin(), cpus.end(), [](const CpuInfo& a, const CpuInfo& b) {\n        if (a.pkg != b.pkg) return a.pkg < b.pkg;\n        if (a.l3 != b.l3) return a.l3 < b.l3;\n        if (a.core != b.core) return a.core < b.core;\n        return a.cpu < b.cpu;\n    });\n    for (size_t i = 1; i < cpus.size(); ++i) {\n        if (cpus[i].pkg == cpus[i - 1].pkg && cpus[i].core == cpus[i - 1].core) cpus[i].smt = cpus[i - 1].smt + 1;\n    }\n\n    // Split into packages: [begin, end) ranges into 'cpus'.\n    std::vector<std::pair<size_t, size_t>> pkgs;\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < cpus.size();) {\n        size_t e = b;\n        while (e < cpus.size() && cpus[e].pkg == cpus[b].pkg) ++e;\n        pkgs.push_back({b, e});\n        b = e;\n    }\n    const size_t ncpu = cpus.size();\n    const size_t nthreads = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads());\n    const bool spreadL3 = getenv(\"CH_NOSPREAD\") == nullptr;  // TEMP toggle\n\n    std::vector<int> map(nthreads);\n    size_t t = 0;\n    for (size_t p = 0; p < pkgs.size(); ++p) {\n        const size_t b = pkgs[p].first, e = pkgs[p].second, size = e - b;\n        // Threads for this package: proportional share, remainder to the last one.\n        const size_t want = (p + 1 == pkgs.size()) ? (nthreads - t)\n                                                   : (nthreads * size + ncpu / 2) / ncpu;\n        if (want == 0) continue;\n\n        // Collect the cores of this package as (l3, core) -> list of cpus by smt.\n        struct Core { int l3; std::vector<int> cpusBySmt; };\n        std::vector<Core> cores;\n        for (size_t i = b; i < e; ++i) {\n            if (i == b || cpus[i].core != cpus[i - 1].core) cores.push_back({cpus[i].l3, {}});\n            cores.back().cpusBySmt.push_back(cpus[i].cpu);\n        }\n        // Order cores round-robin over L3 domains (or sequentially if disabled).\n        std::vector<size_t> coreOrder;\n        if (spreadL3) {\n            std::vector<std::vector<size_t>> groups;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < cores.size(); ++c) {\n                if (c == 0 || cores[c].l3 != cores[c - 1].l3) groups.push_back({});\n                groups.back().push_back(c);\n            }\n            for (size_t k = 0; coreOrder.size() < cores.size(); ++k) {\n                for (const auto& g : groups) {\n                    if (k < g.size()) coreOrder.push_back(g[k]);\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < cores.size(); ++c) coreOrder.push_back(c);\n        }\n\n        std::vector<int> order;\n        order.reserve(size);\n        if (want <= cores.size()) {\n            // Core-first: k-th SMT thread of every core before the (k+1)-th.\n            for (size_t k = 0; order.size() < size; ++k) {\n                for (const size_t c : coreOrder) {\n                    if (k < cores[c].cpusBySmt.size()) order.push_back(cores[c].cpusBySmt[k]);\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Sibling-adjacent: all SMT threads of a core get consecutive ids.\n            for (const size_t c : coreOrder) {\n                for (const int cpu : cores[c].cpusBySmt) order.push_back(cpu);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t k = 0; c < cores.size(); ++c) {\n            if (c == 0 || cores[c].l3 != cores[c - 1].l3) groups.push_back({});\n            groups.back().push_back(static_cast<int>(c));\n        }\n        const bool coreFirst = (want <= cores.size());\n        std::vector<std::vector<int>> groupCpus(groups.size());\n        for (size_t g = 0; Boundary points\n// in x are peeled so the interior loop is branch-free and vectorizable.\ntemplate <typename F>\ninline void laplacianRow(const double* __restrict row, const double* __restrict rowYn,\n                         const double* __restrict rowYp, const double* __restrict rowZn,\n                         const double* __restrict rowZp, const size_t nx, const double dx2,\n                         const double dy2, const double dz2, F&& f) noexcept {\n    if (nx == 1) {\n        f(0, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, 0, 0, 0, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // x = 0 (clamped left neighbour)\n    f(0, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, 0, 0, 1, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n\n    // interior\n#pragma omp simd\n    for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {\n        f(x, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, x, x - 1, x + 1, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n    }\n\n    // x = nx-1 (clamped right neighbour)\n    f(nx - 1, laplacianPoint(row, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, nx - 1, nx - 2, nx - 1, dx2, dy2, dz2));\n}\n\n// The (z, y) row space of the grid is linearised as r = z * ny + y and split\n// into one contiguous range per thread. Each thread computes the chemical\n// potential for its own rows plus one halo plane of rows above and below into\n// a thread-private buffer, then updates its own rows from that buffer. This\n// fuses the two sweeps, keeps mu cache-resident and needs one barrier per\n// time step.\n\n// Compute chemical potential for rows [m0, m1) of 'c' into 'mu' (row m0 of the\n// grid maps to row 0 of 'mu').\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const double* __restrict c, double* __restrict mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const size_t m0, const size_t m1,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    const double dx2 = dx * dx;\n    const double dy2 = dy * dy;\n    const double dz2 = dz * dz;\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    for (size_t r = m0; r < m1; ++r) {\n        const size_t z = r / ny;\n        const size_t y = r - z * ny;\n        const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n        const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n        const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n        const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n        const double* __restrict crow = c + z * plane + y * nx;\n        const double* __restrict rowYn = c + z * plane + yn * nx;\n        const double* __restrict rowYp = c + z * plane + yp * nx;\n        const double* __restrict rowZn = c + zn * plane + y * nx;\n        const double* __restrict rowZp = c + zp * plane + y * nx;\n        double* __restrict murow = mu + (r - m0) * nx;\n        laplacianRow(crow, rowYn, rowYp, rowZn, rowZp, nx, dx2, dy2, dz2,\n                     [=](const size_t x, const double lap) {\n            const double cv = crow[x];\n            murow[x] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB)\n                       + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                       - gamma * lap;\n        });\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update for rows [r0, r1); 'mu' holds rows [m0, ...) of the\n// chemical potential, covering at least one halo plane around [r0, r1).\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(double* __restrict cnew, const double* __restrict cold,\n                        const double* __restrict mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const size_t m0, const size_t r0, const size_t r1,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    const double dx2 = dx * dx;\n    const double dy2 = dy * dy;\n    const double dz2 = dz * dz;\n    const double dtD = dt * D;\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    for (size_t r = r0; r < r1; ++r) {\n        const size_t z = r / ny;\n        const size_t y = r - z * ny;\n        const size_t b = r - m0;  // row index within the mu buffer\n        const size_t byp = (y < ny - 1) ? b + 1 : b;\n        const size_t bzp = (z < nz - 1) ? b + ny : b;\n        const size_t byn = (y > 0) ? b - 1 : b;\n        const size_t bzn = (z > 0) ? b - ny : b;\n        const double* __restrict murow = mu + b * nx;\n        const double* __restrict oldrow = cold + z * plane + y * nx;\n        double* __restrict newrow = cnew + z * plane + y * nx;\n        laplacianRow(murow, mu + byn * nx, mu + byp * nx, mu + bzn * nx, mu + bzp * nx, nx, dx2, dy2, dz2,\n                     [=](const size_t x, const double lap) {\n            newrow[x] = oldrow[x] + dtD * lap;\n        });\n    }\n}\n\n// Contiguous row range [r0, r1) of the R = nz * ny rows owned by thread 'tid'.\ninline void threadRowRange(const size_t R, const int tid, const int nth, size_t& r0, size_t& r1) noexcept {\n    const size_t t = static_cast<size_t>(tid), n = static_cast<size_t>(nth);\n    r0 = (R * t) / n;\n    r1 = (R * (t + 1)) / n;\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:start]+new+s[end:]\n\n# init: use same partition\nstart=s.index('// Initialize concentration field'); r < r1; ++r) {\n            const size_t z = r / ny;\n            const size_t y = r - z * ny;\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]\n                const size_t linear_id = z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));\n                cp[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:start]+new+s[end:]\n\n# main: allocation + loop\nstart=s.index('    // Allocate arrays'); i < r1 * nx; ++i) cn[i] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    printf(\"Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\\\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    // A single parallel region spans the whole time loop. Each thread owns a\n    // contiguous range of (z, y) rows, computes mu for that range plus a halo\n    // plane on each side into a private buffer, and updates its rows. Threads\n    // keep their own copies of the buffer pointers and swap them in lockstep,\n    // so no shared state is mutated between steps.\n#pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const size_t R = nz * ny;\n        size_t r0, r1;\n        threadRowRange(R, omp_get_thread_num(), omp_get_num_threads(), r0, r1);\n        const size_t m0 = (r0 > ny) ? r0 - ny : 0;\n        const size_t m1 = std::min(r1 + ny, R);\n        std::vector<double> mubuf((m1 > m0 ? m1 - m0 : 0) * nx);\n        double* pmu = mubuf.data();\n        double* pold = cold.data();\n        double* pnew = cnew.data();\n        for (int t = 0; t < iterations; ++t) {\n            if (r1 > r0) {\n                // Compute chemical potential (own rows + halo planes)\n                computeChemicalPotential(pold, pmu, nx, ny, nz, m0, m1, dx, dy, dz,\n                                         gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n                // Update concentration (own rows)\n                cahnHilliardUpdate(pnew, pold, pmu, nx, ny, nz, m0, r0, r1, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n            }\n#pragma omp barrier\n            // Swap buffers\n            std::swap(pold, pnew);\n        }\n    }\n    // Mirror the per-step buffer swaps on the owning vectors.\n    if (iterations % 2 != 0) {\n        std::swap(cold, cnew);\n    }\n    \n'''\ns=s[:start]+new+s[end:]\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncmake --build /tmp/chbuild 2>&1 | grep -E \"warning|error\"; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgaFh5xN5w3Qig4i1iup7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The OpenMP parallelization is complete. Only the two existing files were changed, the executable is still `cahn_hilliard`, and the output is bit-identical to the original in every configuration I tested.\n\n**What changed in `cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp`**\n\n- **Kernels run inside one parallel region** that spans the whole time loop. The chemical potential and update sweeps are orphaned `omp for collapse(2)` loops over (z, y) rows with static scheduling, separated by explicit barriers. Each thread swaps its own copies of the buffer pointers in lockstep, and the owning vectors are swapped once at the end for odd iteration counts.\n- **Row-wise stencil with boundary peeling.** The x boundaries are handled outside the inner loop, so the interior is branch-free and vectorizes. Arithmetic order matches the original exactly, so results are bit-exact rather than merely close.\n- **Topology-aware thread pinning.** Unpinned, libgomp's threads migrate across sockets and this barrier-heavy stencil ran up to 20x slower. The program now reads package, core, and L3 topology from sysfs and pins each thread with sched_setaffinity. Each socket gets a contiguous block of thread IDs, threads are divided evenly over L3 domains in blocks, and SMT siblings are used only when the thread count exceeds the core count. This is skipped if OMP_PROC_BIND or OMP_PLACES is set, so user placement wins.\n- **Initialization and validation** are parallelized too, with the same static distribution so first-touch matches the kernels.\n\n**CMakeLists.txt** now requires OpenMP, links OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX, and defaults to a Release build.\n\n**Verification.** Output from the `-r` results block (sum, min, max, samples, hash) matches the original binary exactly for cubic, non-cubic, degenerate (1-wide), odd-iteration, zero-iteration, and odd-thread-count cases. Validation passes. Build is warning-free with -Wall -Wextra.\n\n**Performance at 256³, 40 steps, this 2-socket EPYC 7763 (MCellUpdates/s):**\n\n| Threads | 1 | 8 | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| Throughput | 267 | 1775 | 6391 | 7989 | 9193 | 9321 |\n\nThe serial baseline was about 153, so one thread gained 1.7x from vectorization and the full machine is about 60x. The plateau from 128 to 256 threads is the memory and L3 bandwidth limit.\n\n**One thing I tried and dropped.** A fused kernel with thread-private mu buffers was also bit-exact but slower above 8 threads, because the 256³ working set already fits in the combined L3 and the halo recomputation cost more than the saved traffic. The two-phase version is what's in the file."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":931,"cache_read_input_tokens":71319,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":931},"output_tokens":748,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3f2f82c0-8753-4645-91c3-7ec5487704b7","uuid":"1b514ae7-e74d-401b-b9a0-fa3b94280780","timestamp":"2026-10-31T11:42:23.897Z","request_id":"req_011CgaFh5XZfzgzsWtohecyw"}
